title: Justin Joly would give the Broncos an impact red zone threat at TE

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Justin Joly would give the Broncos an impact red zone threat at TE
sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos are showing interest in and brought in for a pre-draft top-30 visit is former NC State tight end Justin Joly. He is a 6’3.5”, 241-pound tight end prospect who is viewed as one of the better pass-catching tight end prospects in the draft. The Athletic’s Dane Brugler has Joly ranked […]
